title: Span subscript access (span["key"]) on tracing spans: raise a guiding TypeError that names the attribute or span.attributes path, never a generic not-subscriptable error
answers: Why does span["inputs"] fail with 'Span' object is not subscriptable on a trace span?
How do I get the attribute value for a key like mlflow.spanType from a span object?
Where is the error message for subscripting a LiveSpan or Span handled?
Why does span[0] or span["custom_key"] raise TypeError in MLflow tracing?
body:
Path: mlflow/entities/span.py:Span.__getitem__ handles subscript access (span["inputs"], span["name"], span["mlflow.spanType"], span[0]) on tracing spans, both LiveSpan and the immutable Span, when user or agent code indexes a span like a dict.
Rule: Span.__getitem__ always raises TypeError (annotated -> NoReturn) and picks the hint in order: (1) if item is an identifier that is not private and `item in dir(self)`, hint to use `span.<item>`; (2) else if `item in self.attributes` (read via getattr, guarded by try/except), hint to use `span.get_attribute(...)` or `span.attributes[...]`; (3) otherwise a fallback naming span.inputs, span.outputs, span.attributes. Use dir() for the existence probe, not hasattr(), because hasattr runs the property getter.
Symptom: span["inputs"] raised a bare "TypeError: 'Span' object is not subscriptable" with no pointer to span.inputs or to span.attributes, so users and coding agents could not tell where the value lives.
Constraints: Applies to subscript access on tracing span entities. Tested in tests/entities/test_span.py:test_span_subscript_raises_helpful_type_error, which covers properties, custom attributes, dotted keys, private names and non-string indices on both LiveSpan and Span. Does not change normal attribute access.
applies: Tracing span entity subscript access in mlflow/entities/span.py, for LiveSpan and immutable Span.
says: Indexing a trace span with square brackets raises a generic not subscriptable error message.
Tell users which property to access when bracket notation is attempted on trace spans.
Looking up custom trace metadata using bracket indexing offers no guidance on attribute locations.
Guide users toward direct attributes or inputs when indexing operations fail on trace spans.
Square bracket key lookups on trace objects should suggest the proper attribute retrieval syntax.
search: For subscript access on tracing spans (LiveSpan and Span), mlflow/entities/span.py:Span.__getitem__ raises a TypeError providing prioritized hints pointing to standard attributes, custom attributes, or general fallback properties. The lookup checks non-private members via dir() rather than hasattr() to avoid running property getters, followed by checking attributes for key containment. This replaces generic not-subscriptable errors for dotted keys, custom metadata, and non-string indices, without altering standard attribute access.
